paragraphs: From Naas test centre, set off and take the roundabout 1st exit onto John Devoy Road
Stay in lane and take the slight left at the next roundabout exit, continuing on John Devoy Road
At the end of the road turn left onto Newbridge Road
Take your next right onto Old Caragh Road follow Old Caragh Road for about 300 metres
Turn right into Sarto Park bear left through the estate and practice a controlled stop or reverse in a quiet section
When ready, drive back out of Sarto Park, keeping right, and continue straight as the road becomes Pacelli Road
At the end of Pacelli Road turn left onto New Row
Right at the next end of road onto Fairgreen Street
Take your next left onto Ballymore Eustace Road
Left again onto Craddockstown Road, and left into Lakelands
Follow Lakelands around, then carry out a U-turn where safe to practice this manoeuvre
Retrace out of Lakelands, keeping right right at the end of the road, and right again onto Craddockstown Road
Turn left onto Ballymore Eustace Road and follow it to the roundabout, taking the slight left exit onto the R447 toward South Ring
Continue on toward the Kilcullen Road rotary, taking the left exit onto Kilcullen Road
Along Kilcullen Road, be ready to pull in on the left for a safe stop, then perform a U-turn on the unnamed side road to practice reversing and turnabout skills
Rejoin Kilcullen Road, going straight as it becomes Fairgreen Street and then Main Street South
Turn left onto Sallins Road right onto Wolfe Tone Street, left onto Dublin Road, and right onto Blessington Road
To loop back toward the test centre turn right onto Friary Road
Left onto Corban's Lane, continuing left onto Loughbwee
Take a right onto Fairgreen Street, left onto New Row, and left onto John Devoy Road
At the roundabout take the slight left and follow the exit back into the Naas test centre on John Devoy Road
